LESSON: LOCATION, POSITION AND SIZE OF KENYA

Grade: Grade 5
Subject: SOCIAL STUDIES
Strand: Natural and Historic Built Environments
Topic 1.2: Location, Position and Size of Kenya

SECTION 1: WELCOME

• Today’s class: Location, Position and Size of Kenya
• How we learn: Teach → Worked example → Try this
• Use point notes. Show working. Then take the quiz.
• Big question: What is the position of Kenya in relation to her neighbours?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

1. identify countries that neighbour Kenya
2. value good relations between Kenya and her neighbours

SECTION 3: CLASS STUDY (TEACH → EXAMPLE → TRY)

▸ Skill 1: identify countries that neighbour Kenya

Teach
• Today’s focus: identify countries that neighbour Kenya.
• Listen/read the idea.
• Watch/study the model.
• Then do Try this.

Worked example
• Model A for “identify countries that neighbour Kenya” using a school example.
• Model B for “identify countries that neighbour Kenya” using a home/county example.

Try this
• Your turn: show "identify countries that neighbour Kenya" in 3 bullet points.
• Share with a partner and improve one bullet.

▸ Skill 2: value good relations between Kenya and her neighbours

Teach
• Today’s focus: value good relations between Kenya and her neighbours.
• Listen/read the idea.
• Watch/study the model.
• Then do Try this.

Worked example
• Model A for “value good relations between Kenya and her neighbours” using a school example.
• Model B for “value good relations between Kenya and her neighbours” using a home/county example.

Try this
• Your turn: show "value good relations between Kenya and her neighbours" in 3 bullet points.
• Share with a partner and improve one bullet.


SECTION: QUICK EXAMPLES

• Model 1: identify countries that neighbour Kenya
• Model 2: value good relations between Kenya and her neighbours

SECTION: PRACTICE NOW

1. Practise: identify countries that neighbour Kenya
2. Practise: value good relations between Kenya and her neighbours

SECTION: WORK TO DO

1. Make a one-page revision sheet for Location, Position and Size of Kenya.
2. Teach someone at home for 2 minutes using bullet points only.

SECTION: THINK ABOUT IT

1. What is the position of Kenya in relation to her neighbours?

SECTION: REMEMBER

• identify countries that neighbour Kenya
• value good relations between Kenya and her neighbours

• Next: complete the Revision Quiz. Open Answers only after you finish.

— CBC Learn · Classroom study notes (Strategy 2)
